family: All labelled signs on n=0,1,2 plus fixed n=3 masks 1,7,105,150; finite physical stopping trees and fresh-parity tensor point activations

tree_policies: adaptive up to two singleton queries

pilot_domain: all n<=1 seeds, same tree/reference modes; activations n<=1,m=1,ell=2,k=1
arithmetic: Integer direct character sums (no FWHT), Fraction probabilities/influence, exact prime-log coefficient dictionaries; no numerical logarithms
